facts.claim: Median growth for companies between 1 million and 30 million dollars ARR is 26%, with top performers at 40% to 50%
facts.source_title: Rule of 40 in SaaS: 2026 Data, Benchmarks and Valuation Impact
facts.excerpt: For companies in the $1M-$30M ARR range, median growth is 26%, while top performers grow at 40-50%.

facts.claim: Bootstrapped SaaS companies between 3 million and 20 million dollars ARR grow at a 15% median
facts.excerpt: SaaS Capital's 2026 private B2B SaaS benchmark shows median revenue growth of 15% for bootstrapped SaaS companies with $3m to $20m ARR.

facts.claim: Between 20% and 40% of total subscription churn is payment failure rather than cancellation
facts.excerpt: Companies that measure only active cancellations miss the 20 to 40% of total churn driven by payment failures.

facts.claim: Smart retry alone recovers about 40% of failed payments, a card updater 25%, and dunning email adds 15 to 20% on top
facts.excerpt: Smart retry alone recovers 40%, card updater 25%, and emails add 15-20% on top; combining all three reaches 70%.

facts.claim: Monthly churn of 5% to 12% is typical for mobile subscription apps, with the best holding under 5%
facts.excerpt: For mobile subscription apps, monthly churn of 5-12% is typical, with the best apps under 5%.

facts.claim: The median subscription app earns 492 US dollars a month, and 59.3% never pass 1,000 dollars in total revenue
facts.excerpt: The median subscription app earns $492 per month, with 59.3% making less than $1,000 total
